raw_segments.text: He led the poles, not into the large room where the chorus of girls was assembling and
the table was being laid, but into the bedroom on the right, where the trunks and packages
were kept, and there were two large beds, with pyramids of cotton pillows on each.
There was a lighted candle on a small deal table in the corner.
The small man and Midia sat down to this table, facing each other, while the huge Vrubovsky
stood beside them, his hands behind his back.
The poles looked severe, but were evidently inquisitive.
